selected_script.angle: Replacing wasteful and frustrating cling wrap with a reusable steam-generating cover
selected_script.hook: Stop ruining your meals with sagging, sticky plastic wrap.

video_001_part_01.purpose: pain conflict, product solution, fast-cut scene 1
video_001_part_01.description: 0-3s: Close-up of a person frustratedly trying to peel melted, sticky plastic wrap off a plate of hot food. 3-6s: The UFORU clear domed microwave cover with a light green rim is smoothly placed over a fresh plate of food, instantly solving the hassle. 6-10s: Close-up pouring water into the side transparent reservoir box and adjusting the top green rotatable air vent.

video_001_part_02.description: 0-4s: The covered plate spins inside a microwave; steam circulates inside the clear dome while the microwave walls remain completely spotless. 4-8s: Hand easily lifts the cover by the integrated raised green handle, revealing perfectly moist food, while the bottom drainage groove safely holds extra condensation. 8-10s: Light CTA text overlay 'A simple upgrade for everyday use' as the clean cover rests on a kitchen counter.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video in 9:16 realistic handheld phone-shot style. Timeline: 0-3s: Show a real-life wrong behavior—close-up of a person frustratedly peeling melted, sticky plastic wrap off a plate of hot food. 3-6s: Quickly introduce the product as the direct solution, smoothly placing the clear transparent domed microwave cover with a light green base rim and integrated handle over a fresh plate of food. 6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing water being poured into the side transparent water reservoir box with a green lid, and a hand turning the top green rotatable air vent knob. Keep pacing fast, clear, and product-focused. Use the provided product reference images as the exact product identity. Do not change the clear dome, green rim, or handle. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not include a CTA in this segment.

Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video in 9:16 realistic handheld phone-shot style.
